title: Attack
body:
Syntax: attack <target>  (alias: kill)

Description: Starts a fight with a mob in the room, or (if 'group' or PvP is set up) with another player. Once combat starts, your basic attack resolves automatically every pulse until the fight ends -- you don't need to re-type it each round. The verb shown (slash/stab/punch/etc.) matches whatever you're wielding. See 'help combatstats' for how Hit Roll, Armor Class, Dodge, and Critical Chance factor into each swing.

Date: 2026-08-17
